title: manifest.json of a memory export (prisma-memory-export/1)
description: The last entry of a complete export archive. An archive without it is incomplete (EXPORT-INCOMPLETE.txt says why). See README.md of this folder.

version.description: Version of this contract the archive was written with.

by.description: Login of the person who exported; null for an export by the server job.

skipped.description: What is not in the archive and why: no_access (records of the space the exporting person cannot read), gone (deleted while the export ran), moving (space export: records the person reads whose class was being changed while the export ran: in neither class at that moment; export again to include them; the whole-instance export writes such records, marked hidden, and has no moving), moved (records that changed class while the export ran and were already written under their earlier class: the later copy is skipped, each record is in the archive once), original_missing (the stored file could not be found; the record is in the archive with original.missing = true), original_unchecked (an open record whose conversion and secrets check are not done: the record is in the archive, its file is not, original.withheld = unchecked), originals_excluded (whole-instance export with originals left out on request: the record is in the archive, its file is not, original.withheld = excluded), no_space (whole-instance export: records whose space is not a space of this instance; they are not in the archive). Other keys may appear in later minor versions.

indexLine.description: One line of index.jsonl (one JSON object per line, one line per record).

bytes.description: Size of the original in bytes; null without an original in the archive.
